cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the course is to explain, both theoretically andpractically, the economics of nursery operations, the issues surrounding subsidy managementand the necessary steps for preparing, implementing and completing projects. The aim is also to familiarize studentswith various online databases and systems for submitting subsidy and projectapplications.
